description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2815011796083 JACKSCREW-SEAT ASSE: Line 0001 Qty 21 UI AY Deliver To: By: 0110 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
